description: Fetch a web page and return its main readable content as Markdown, with navigation, ads and boilerplate stripped. HTML only: any other content type is refused rather than guessed at. No JavaScript is executed, so a page that builds its text in the browser comes back with little or nothing, and the response says so. Network: needs the target website. Optional packages: jsdom, turndown, @mozilla/readability. Without them this tool reports what is missing instead of guessing.

url.description: The http(s) URL of the page to read. Fetching is SSRF-guarded.

name: read_url
